title: What is the Deloitte consulting interview process, and how should you prepare?
description: How Deloitte consulting hires, including Monitor Deloitte: online assessments, video interviews, case and group exercises, and the free official practice…
hook: Deloitte is the largest of the Big Four consulting practices, and it hires a great many graduates and experienced professionals. Its process differs by country and by practice, so the first step is knowing which part of Deloitte you are applying to.
body:
Know which Deloitte you are applying to

Deloitte member firms run their own processes, and a role labelled Consulting can differ from Monitor Deloitte (strategy), Risk Advisory or Technology. In the US, consulting recruiting is organised around practice groups, and the type of case you receive depends on the group. Strategy roles look most like MBB cases.

A typical UK early-careers process

For the main UK graduate, summer and placement routes, Deloitte's assessment guidance describes five stages: online application, an immersive online assessment, a job simulation, a final-stage assessment, and the outcome. Some programmes combine stages.

Case and group exercises

Candidates frequently report a mix of individual case interviews, competency questions and a group exercise. In the US, prep guides describe a first round pairing a behavioural interview with one or two cases, and a final round that adds a group case. How to stand out in a group case.

Monitor Deloitte

Monitor Deloitte's process is closer to MBB, with candidate-led cases, and can include written cases with preparation time and group cases.

How to prepare

  • Use Deloitte's free case interview practice tool and its case interview tips page.
  • Practise timed numerical and logical reasoning for the online assessment.
  • Practise short, clear video answers if your route uses a recorded interview.
  • Prepare competency stories (teamwork, agility, delivering under pressure) as well as cases.

Sources

  • Deloitte: Case interview tips and prep tools
  • Deloitte: Case interview practice tool
  • MyConsultingCoach: Deloitte consulting recruiting
  • Hacking the Case Interview: Deloitte case interview

Checked November 2026. Processes change by office and year, so always confirm with the firm's own careers page and your recruiter.

Adapt the same business problem to the role

Take a manufacturer whose order fulfilment costs have risen 20%. A strategy candidate might compare whether to expand warehouses, renegotiate contracts or change the customer promise. An operations candidate should map the fulfilment process and identify the bottleneck. A technology candidate should test whether fragmented inventory systems cause rework and delays. All three need to quantify the impact and recommend a sensible next test.

For example, if 100,000 orders each cost £12 to fulfil, a 20% cost increase adds £240,000 annually if volume is unchanged. If the cause is a higher proportion of urgent orders, automation may be a poor first answer; the operational response might be demand planning and service-tier pricing. The maths is simple, but it tells you which workstream matters.

Ask the recruiter which business unit you are interviewing for, which assessment exercises are planned and whether the case is individual, group or presentation-based. Do not assume a global Deloitte interview script applies to every member firm, seniority or practice.
